comparison.objective: Index a workpiece by one of seven equal divisions on a dividing head; the body only names the task directory.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate and lock a rotary indexing mechanism to a discrete angular division, not align a break-off mandrel and strike it.
comparison.success_condition: Workpiece advanced exactly one-seventh revolution and presumably secured; angular tolerance and lock-state rubric are missing.
comparison.reason: Discrete rotary indexing is a different mechanism, ability, and terminal state from fracture and fragment containment.
